phase_name: Do not charge for a read -- in-session plan cache

objectives.description: Add plan_cache field to mt_state_file initializer
Write plan_cache in emit_and_exit only when a dispatch row was built
On entry, check for a plan_cache match and replay without charging
Add test group: replay identical, then charge after postflight

approaches_tried.approach: Left the pre-existing stop-after-last-named Group 4/5 test unmodified with the new plan cache active
approaches_tried.reason: the group calls the SUT twice with the same session and no simulated postflight; the new cache correctly replayed run 1's plan on run 2, breaking the fall-through assertion. Fixed by adding --no-plan-cache to that group's two run_sut calls, since the group's own domain is unrelated to plan-cache behavior.
